name: list_notes
description: List the notes in the Longhand storage folder, newest first. Filter by note type, tags, a date range, title text, busy state or a keyword. A keyword result says whether the keyword is in the title, tags, manual notes, summary or transcript. Use get_note with a note_id to read a note.

note_type.description:
Only notes of this note type. "General" gives the notes that are not
in a type folder. Case does not count.

tags.description:
Only notes with each of these tags. Case and the spaces around `::`
do not count. A tag that ends in `::`, for example "Person::",
matches each tag with that scope.

since.description: Only notes that started on this day or later, as YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Only notes that started on this day or earlier, as YYYY-MM-DD.

title.description: Only notes whose title contains this text. Case does not count.

keyword.description:
Only notes that contain this text in the title, the tags, the manual
notes, the summary or the transcript. Case does not count. Each
result says where the text is.

busy.description:
Only busy notes (true) or only notes that are not busy (false). A
note is busy when a computer records or processes it, when its
recording is not saved yet, or when a move to another type waits.

limit.description:
The most notes in the result, from 1 to 200. The default is 50. The
newest notes come first.

input_schema.description:
The input of list notes. Every filter is optional, and a note must
match all the filters that the input gives.
input_schema.title: ListNotesInput

matching.description: The number of notes that match, also those over the limit.

truncated.description: True when more notes match than the result holds.

keyword_search_incomplete.description:
True when the keyword search stopped at its time limit, so that
some notes were not searched.

problems.description:
Folders that look like note folders but give no note, for example a
note that a newer Longhand wrote.

note_id.description: The id to give to get note.

duplicate_folders.description: Other folders with the same note id. Get note refuses such an id.

keyword_in.description: Where the keyword is. Only with a keyword.

MatchPart.description: A part of a note where the keyword is.

folder.description: The folder, relative to the storage folder.

ProblemFolder.description: A folder that looks like a note folder but gives no note.

oneOf.description: The records have not come from the sync yet.

The folder, or a file that defines the note, links to another
place.

ProblemFolderKind.description: The kind of a folder that gives no note.
